editorial.blurb: Bamboo Garden serves generous portions of classic Chinese comfort food in a serene setting, with hot & sour soup and orange chicken earning devoted fans.
editorial.insiderTip: Check the menu posted outside for coupons before ordering—regulars score free appetizers and drinks. Stick to entrées like orange chicken and lo mein for better value; skip the appetizers, which reviewers say are undersized for the price.
